all_videos_in_window.description:
Everyone says striped bass go deep when the water warms — these fish clearly didn't get the memo. At 9am, in bright sun and 70-something degree water, dozens of stripers were cruising a Nantucket Sound flat in barely a foot of crystal-clear water. 

They were incredibly tough to fool, but just watching them glide through water that shallow was impressive. Anyone else found stripers recently somewhere they 'weren't supposed to be'? Drop a comment below — love to hear about it. 

Tight lines! 🎣

Ryan

Everyone says striped bass go deep when the water warms — these fish clearly didn't get the memo. At 9am, in bright sun and 70-something degree water, dozens of stripers were cruising a Nantucket Sound flat in barely a foot of crystal-clear water.

Tight lines! 🎣

all_videos.title: LBI Fishing Report 8/11/26
all_videos.description:
August fishing is in full swing here on Long Beach Island, NJ and there is a lot happening right now from the LBI surf , Barnegat Inlet, Barnegat Bay and the nearshore waters.

In this August 11, 2026 LBI Fishing Report, I cover the latest fluke, bluefish, kingfish, striped bass, tog, weakfish, croaker and late summer fishing opportunities around Long Beach Island.

Ocean fluke fishing is one of the biggest stories right now. Over the past couple weeks I've had some very good trips fishing wrecks and structure outside Barnegat Inlet, with recent trips producing 4 - 7 keeper fluke each trip along with plenty of shorts. all_videos.title: August 20th 2026 Long Island Metro Fishing Report with Matthew Broderick
all_videos.description: This week’s Long Island Fishing Forecast is packed with late-summer action from one end of the Island to the other. Bluefin tuna remain within reach of inshore and nearshore anglers, while ocean fluking continues to gain momentum with quality fish hitting the decks. Blacktip and spinner sharks are crashing bunker pods just off the South Shore, cobia are popping up in the ocean, and bonito and bluefish are providing fast-paced action out West. We’ll also check in with our correspondents, cover the latest offshore report, highlight upcoming events, and take a look at the newest Dreamboat Challenge entries and leaderboard.

all_videos.title: August 20th 2026 New England Video Fishing Forecast with Dave Anderson
all_videos.description: Something changed this week; the average temp slipped a bit, the new moon passed, and suddenly the fish seem to be giving us a fall preview. Striper action has caught fire north of the Cape with some seriously big fish in the mix from Maine to Boston and beyond. While the continued mackerel influx is mixing stripers and bonito in ferocious feeds, with a side of dolphins, in and around Narragansett Bay. At the same time, we’ve seen a strong push of rec-size bluefin feeding south of Block and there are some confirmed fish moving in tighter now, as well.
